title: Zambia districts 2022
description:
The administrative district boundaries were generated at a scale of 1:10,000 and validated against official district narratives provided by the Government of the Republic of Zambia, using high resolution imagery and 1:50,000 topographic maps. The shapefile covers the National, 10 Provincial and 116 District Boundaries. This dataset has been officially endorsed by the Office of the Surveyor General. The district narratives used to update the district shapefiles are dated up to 2017.

Note: THIS MAP SHOULD NOT BE CONSIDERED AUTHORITY ON THE DELIMITATION OF INTERNATIONAL BOUNDARY.
snippet: The 2022 district administrative district boundaries were generated through a collaborative effort of the Office of the Surveyor General, Local Government and Housing, Electoral Commission of Zambia, Central Statistical Office and the University of Zambia - Geography and Environmental Studies Department. The shapefile is one of the fundamental datasets on the National Spatial Data Infrastructure (NSDI) portal. Updated district and provincial boundaries will support accurate analysis of geospatial data across different administrative units.
accessInformation:
